messages:
maria: Heads up — we're seeing a short spike of 5xx + timeouts hitting hosted inference in us-west-2 since ~10:02. 5xx rate ~6% over the last 5m, p95 latency doubled. customer support getting alerts from 3 customers.

alex: on it, pulling traces. seeing a fanout increase to the gateway from a single customer job. likely backend queueing.

sam: throwing autoscale a nudge; scaling policies didn't kick for model-pool-mlg-1, investigating.

maria: quick mitigation: please enable circuit-breaker for that customer route and fallback to model-small variant. can we also turn up prefork counts on the gateway?

nina: added a temporary route override to send traffic to fallback, and increased max inflight for the pool. rolling now.

ops-bot: deploy started by nina — route override + pool config (PR #4621).

alex: reproducer from customer: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"mlg-1","input":"<long prompt>"}'
```
returns 502 / timeout 30s. getting trace id `t-8b7c2d` in gateway logs.

sam: logs show sustained KV cache stalls on serving nodes; some nodes hit OOM-kernel reclaim and GC thrash during the fanout. KV-cache miss rate jumped.

maria: action items for immediate follow-up: 1) triage nodes with OOM events (sam) 2) investigate why autoscaler didn't add nodes (alex) 3) postmortem + customer comms draft (maria/support).

nina: added a temporary per-customer rate limiter (10rps) to stop cascades. observing 5xx back down to ~0.8% after fallback.

support-bot: notified CS: ticket #C-1198 linked.

alex: root cause hypothesis: a very high-fanout batch job from a partner created a cold-KV storm; serving runtime didn't reclaim cache entries fast enough and memory pressure caused kernel OOM on some hosts. autoscaler thresholds were tuned for steady-state, not sudden bursts.

maria: short-term mitigations that we applied: fallback routing, per-customer rate limiting, route override to smaller model, bumped pool prefork, restarted 3 OOM'd nodes. customer impact reduced.

sam: longer-term actions proposed: 1) autoscaler: add burst headroom heuristic and faster scale-up for sudden fanout; 2) runtime: make KV cache eviction more aggressive under memory pressure; 3) add a live alert for KV cache miss rate + node OOM trend; 4) runbook entry for customer-sourced fanouts.

maria: assigning owners: autoscaler (alex), runtime/evictions (sam), alerts & dashboards (nina), postmortem doc + CS comms (maria). please ack.

alex: ack, will start a canary test for autoscale changes and open PR.

sam: ack, will draft runtime patch and perf test.

nina: ack, will add dashboard panels and incident alert thresholds.

maria: thanks — capturing timeline & action items in the postmortem doc. we'll have a short customer-facing summary in the ticket by EOD. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: incident resolved (reduced 5xx to baseline). Follow-up: create postmortem in /docs/incidents and schedule 30m blameless review tomorrow.

maria: one more note — check billing spikes for that partner job; if it's an internal partner test we should throttle on their account too.

support-bot: billing notified, created billing ticket #B-884.

alex: attaching trace snippets and host OOM logs to the postmortem doc.

maria: thanks team. we'll reconvene after the draft is up. :pray:
